queries.query: Selecting a membrane process for a defined PFAS feed water. Prepare a focused, comparative review of how membrane processes should be selected for a specified PFAS composition, water matrix, and treatment objective.
Compare nanofiltration, reverse osmosis, adsorptive membranes, electrically assisted membranes, and relevant hybrid configurations by separation mechanism.
Evaluate effects of PFAS properties, membrane characteristics, pressure or flux, recovery, ions, organic matter, and fouling.
Define when reported rejection, adsorption, permeability, and energy results are sufficiently comparable to support process selection.
